reference_sql:
WITH table_side AS (
  -- one row: the units weekly_units holds for ISO week 11 of 2025
  SELECT SUM(units) AS weekly_units_total
  FROM weekly_units
  WHERE iso_year = 2025
    AND iso_week = 11
), sales_side AS (
  -- one row: the units in sales from Monday 10 to Sunday 16 March 2025 (UTC days), 0 when there are none
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(units), 0) AS sales_units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-10' AND DATE '2025-03-16'
)
SELECT t.weekly_units_total, s.sales_units,
  t.weekly_units_total - s.sales_units AS difference
FROM table_side t
CROSS JOIN sales_side s
alternatives:
WITH table_side AS (
  -- one row: the units weekly_units holds for ISO week 11 of 2025
  SELECT SUM(units) AS weekly_units_total
  FROM weekly_units
  WHERE iso_year = 2025
    AND iso_week = 11
), sales_side AS (
  -- one row: the units in sales on the days calendar puts in ISO week 11 of 2025, 0 when there are none
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0) AS sales_units
  FROM sales s
  JOIN calendar c ON c.cal_date = s.order_date
  WHERE c.iso_year = 2025
    AND c.iso_week = 11
)
SELECT t.weekly_units_total, s.sales_units,
  t.weekly_units_total - s.sales_units AS difference
FROM table_side t
CROSS JOIN sales_side s

solver.query:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT SUM(units) AS u FROM weekly_units WHERE week_start = DATE '2025-03-10'
), s AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(units), 0) AS u FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-03-10' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-03-16'
)
SELECT w.u AS weekly_units_total, s.u AS sales_units, w.u - s.u AS difference
FROM w CROSS JOIN s
